plugin.name: CDShelf
plugin.title: CD Shelf
plugin.desc: A jewel-case style album shelf for Lyrion Music Server, based on the original project by Reddit user ChrisHoppyBot. Includes Material integration, player selection, standard and full-width views.
plugin.changes: Adds Previous, Play/Pause and Next controls to the player bar. Removes the volume control and automatic screensaver mode so the CD shelf remains visible indefinitely. Includes release notes.
plugin.creator: ChrisHoppyBot; Joe Leech
